title: An improvement of the large sieve for square moduli under Hooley's hypothesis $R^*$ for short Salié sums
summary: Let $S(Q,M,N,(a_n))=\sum_{q\le Q}\sum_{a\bmod q^2,(a,q)=1}|\sum_{M<n\le M+N}a_ne(an/q^2)|^2$ be Zhao's large sieve sum with square moduli. Zhao conjectured that $S\ll(QN)^ε(Q^3+N)\sum|a_n|^2$. The bound of Baier and Zhao (2008) exceeds this conjecture by a factor which reaches $Q^{1/2}$ at the critical point $N=Q^3$, and there the exponent $1/2$ has not been lowered since. We prove that, under Hooley's Hypothesis $R^*$ for short Salié sums, $S\ll(QN)^ε(Q^3+N+Q^{4/3}N^{2/3})\sum|a_n|^2$. This replaces the excess over Zhao's conjecture by its $2/3$-th power throughout the range…
